context: Checks that doctor-driven diagnosis, a re-run of install, and a version check are performed, without loosening the pins.

checklist.name: Runs mise doctor after the failure
checklist.description: Uses mise doctor to diagnose the install failure

checklist.name: Treats doctor output as the diagnosis
checklist.description: Reads the PATH and plugin findings from doctor output rather than guessing

checklist.name: Resolves PATH issue
checklist.description: Fixes the shims or PATH problem identified by doctor

checklist.name: Resolves plugin issue
checklist.description: Installs or corrects the missing plugin identified by doctor

checklist.name: Re-runs mise install
checklist.description: Runs mise install again after the fix

checklist.name: Re-validates with mise doctor
checklist.description: Runs mise doctor again and expects no errors

checklist.name: Checks active versions with mise ls
checklist.description: Runs mise ls to confirm each tool shows the pinned version as active

checklist.name: Compares against pinned values
checklist.description: States the expected versions are node 22.4.0 and python 3.12.3 from mise.toml

checklist.name: Keeps exact pins
checklist.description: Does not change the pins to latest or a range to make the install pass

checklist.name: Does not add secrets or credentials
checklist.description: Does not put tokens or credentials into mise.toml while troubleshooting
